name: waiting-weather
description: Rain or snow falls across your screen while Claude Code is blocked on you (Windows), and an optional Apprise push when you are away

delay_seconds.title: Delay (seconds) (default: 10)
delay_seconds.description: How long Claude must wait on you before the alert goes out

question_effect.title: Question effect (default: snow)
question_effect.description: Screen effect for a question, plan approval or input dialog

question_color.title: Question color (default: #FFFFFF)
question_color.description: Hex color of the question effect

permission_effect.title: Permission effect (default: rain)
permission_effect.description: Screen effect for a permission prompt

permission_color.title: Permission color (default: #60A5FA)
permission_color.description: Hex color of the permission effect

max_seconds.title: Maximum effect length (seconds) (default: 120)
max_seconds.description: The effect stops when you unblock Claude, or after this long at most

remote_url.title: Remote alert URL (default: empty, off)
remote_url.description: Where the question, its options or the command goes when Claude waits too long: an Apprise API notify endpoint (https://host/notify/<key>), a Telegram sendMessage URL (https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage?chat_id=<id>) or a Google Chat webhook URL. Empty turns remote alerts off

remote_tag.title: Remote alert tag (default: empty)
remote_tag.description: Apprise tag that picks which services the remote alert goes to. Empty sends to every service of the key. Ignored for Telegram and Google Chat

remote_delay_seconds.title: Remote alert delay (seconds) (default: 60)
remote_delay_seconds.description: How long Claude must wait on you before the remote alert goes out
